insights.title: Your patterns
insights.subtitle: INTERRUPT learns from what happens over time.

home.title: You don't need more willpower.
home.subtitle: You need a way to interrupt the moment.

behavior.title: What are you about to do?
behavior.subtitle: Choose what is pulling you right now.

intensity.title: How strong is the urge right now?
intensity.subtitle: 0 means barely there. 10 means extremely strong.

expectation.title: What do you expect it to give you?
expectation.subtitle: What are you really looking for right now?

reassess.title: How strong is the urge now?
reassess.subtitle: There is no right answer. Just be honest.

outcome.title: What happened?
outcome.subtitle: Whatever happened, your answer helps INTERRUPT learn.

interrupted.title: I interrupted it
interrupted.description: I chose not to act on the urge.

delayed.title: I delayed it
delayed.description: I gave myself some time before acting.

messages.same: The urge didn't move this time.
messages.higher: The urge got stronger. That is useful information too.

footer.private: Your data stays on this device.

nameIt.title: NAME IT
nameIt.instruction: Let's separate the urge from you.
nameIt.firstPrompt: Complete this: “I am having the urge to…”
nameIt.placeholder: I am having the urge to...
nameIt.secondPrompt: Now try this: “My brain is telling me to…”
nameIt.placeholder2: My brain is telling me to...

promise.title: THE PROMISE
promise.intro: Your brain is making you an offer.
promise.durationQuestion: If you do it, how long do you expect the feeling to last?
promise.durationPlaceholder: A few minutes, an hour, most of the day...
promise.afterQuestion: And what usually happens after that?

wave.title: RIDE THE WAVE
wave.instruction: Don't fight the urge. Watch it.
wave.timerIntro: Stay with the sensation for 60 seconds.

delay.title: NOT NOW
delay.instruction: You don't have to decide forever.
delay.promise: Just don't do it for the next 10 minutes.
delay.waiting: You don't have to do anything. Just let the ten minutes pass.

changeScene.title: CHANGE THE SCENE
changeScene.step2: Put the device or object down.

actualNeed.title: WHAT DO YOU ACTUALLY NEED?
actualNeed.intro: Forget the behavior for a second.
actualNeed.question: What do you actually need?

suggestions.stimulation: Give your brain something new for 90 seconds.
suggestions.relief: Take a slow breath and deliberately relax your shoulders.
suggestions.comfort: Move somewhere physically comfortable and give yourself two quiet minutes.
suggestions.escape: Step away from the situation for two minutes.
suggestions.connection: Send one simple message to someone you trust.
suggestions.control: Choose one small thing around you that you can control right now.
suggestions.rest: Put everything down for two minutes and let yourself stop.
suggestions.unknown: You don't need to know yet. Just create two minutes of distance.

breakChain.title: BREAK THE CHAIN
breakChain.question: What happened right before the urge?
breakChain.result: That's useful. Now interrupt the chain here.

twoFutures.title: TWO FUTURES
twoFutures.intro: Look at the two paths without judging either one.

switch90.title: 90 SECOND SWITCH
switch90.instruction: No thinking. Just do something else for 90 seconds.
switch90.task1: Find five things around you that are blue.

realityCheck.title: REALITY CHECK
realityCheck.question: What do you think will happen if you do it?
realityCheck.past: Has this actually happened consistently before?

previousSuccess.title: WHAT WORKED LAST TIME?
previousSuccess.message: Last time, this approach helped reduce the urge.

generic.instruction: Create some distance between the urge and the action.
